data.argument: This is a constructive print: PCYO delivered broad-based operating momentum, with revenue up 60%, EBITDA up 29%, net income up 31%, and diluted EPS up 33% year over year. The strongest acceleration came from water and wastewater revenue, up 119%, alongside a more than eightfold increase in water deliveries and continued expected oil-and-gas demand through 2026. Housing execution also remains supportive: lot sales rose 19%, tap volumes increased, Phase 2D is targeted for substantial completion by fiscal year-end, and management expects $14.8 million of milestone and finished-lot payments over the next 12 months. Rentals are beginning to scale, with most of 23 contracted units expected online in calendar 2026. The unchanged model reflects reported earnings, not deteriorating fundamentals.
key_points: Broad-based growth exceeded available peer revenue trends.
Water demand and Sky Ranch monetization remain thesis-supportive.
Phase 2D, Phase 2E, and rentals provide visible catalysts.
assumptions: Management achieves stated Phase 2D and Phase 2E timelines.
Oil-and-gas water demand continues through the remainder of 2026.
The $14.8 million payment outlook is realized over the next 12 months.
